rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact: BZ gapped down on 5.7x relative volume, opened at its high ($16.03), and the bounce off $15.29 has stalled for five straight minutes just below VWAP ($15.52) and the 9-EMA ($15.54), with a risk-off tape (SPY -0.25%, VIXY +1.04%) favoring the short side. Risk to the $15.57 invalidation is ~$0.08 versus ~$0.18 of room to the $15.31 target, preserving roughly 2:1 reward/risk, and there is no evidence of a VWAP reclaim that would justify closing or flipping.
